name: ual_parse
description: Read a Microsoft 365 unified audit log export and explode the AuditData column, which is JSON and is where almost everything lives. Normalises each row, summarises by operation, user and address, and flags the operations that matter: inbox rules, forwarding, consents, anonymous links and mailbox reads.

path.description: A CSV or JSON export, or a directory of them

notable_only.description: Only the operations this tool flags as worth a look
